title: Claude Code Context Rot
caption:
Your Claude Code session gets dumber the longer you work in a single terminal session.

Here's what actually happens when an agent runs shell tools:

1. Claude Code — the CLI agent formats a user request into a tool invocation call.
2. Terminal Exec — the underlying shell runner executes commands like build tools or test suites.
3. Raw Output — standard output returns thousands of verbose log lines back to the agent.
4. Context Window — unfiltered terminal logs fill context space, diluting instructions and causing context rot.

When terminal outputs fill the context window, prompt space for reasoning drops and error rates spike.

No magic — just finite context buffers handling uncontrolled stdout streams.

takeaway: Filter terminal output before it poisons your agent context.
